short: High thermoelectric performance at room temperature of n-typ
title: High thermoelectric performance at room temperature of n-type Mg3Bi2-based materials by Se doping

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: n-type Mg3Sb2-based Zintl materials perform poorly near room temperature. Alloying towards Mg3Bi2 and doping with Se should lift the carrier concentration while keeping mobility high.
states.detail: Absorbed: n2 (HYP/gap), n3 (HYP/hypothesis), n4 (DES/base_system), n5 (DES/modification), n6 (DES/variable_sweep), n7 (DES/route), n8 (PRC/treatment), n9 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Every composition is single-phase Mg3Sb2-type (P-3m1) with no impurity reflections. The body is dense and cleaves along layers, exposing coarse facets tens of microns across

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Se substitution brings the K-point conduction valley down to the Fermi level, raising the valley degeneracy. Carrier concentration rises from 0.55 to 3.4e19 cm-3 with Se while mobility stays at 127-168 cm2/V/s.
states.detail: Absorbed: n13 (PRP/descriptor), n14 (PRP/descriptor), n15 (MEC/pathway), n16 (PRP/value), n17 (PRP/value), n18 (PRP/value), n19 (MEC/tradeoff). Premises: Single parabolic band Pisarenko relation, Wiedemann-Franz for the electronic heat flow, and the engineering ZT formalism

states.title: Performance state
states.head: ZT is 0.82 at 300 K and peaks at 1.24 near 498 K. As a module leg from 300 to 623 K it gives an engineering ZT near 0.84 and about 12% conversion efficiency

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Se doping of a Bi-rich Mg3Sb2 Zintl gives a Te-free n-type thermoelectric that works at room temperature
